ensure_single_default_filter.body: BEGIN IF NEW.is_default = true THEN UPDATE public.saved_filters SET is_default = false WHERE user_id = NEW.user_id AND entity_type = NEW.entity_type AND id != NEW.id AND is_default = true; END IF; RETURN NEW; END;

handle_new_user.body: BEGIN INSERT INTO public.profiles (user_id, nome, email) VALUES ( NEW.id, COALESCE(NEW.raw_user_meta_data ->> 'nome', NEW.email), NEW.email ); INSERT INTO public.user_roles (user_id, role) VALUES (NEW.id, 'rh'); RETURN NEW; END;

update_vaga_metrics.body: BEGIN UPDATE public.vagas SET total_candidatos = ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.processos_seletivos WHERE vaga_id = COALESCE(NEW.vaga_id, OLD.vaga_id) ), em_processo = ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.processos_seletivos WHERE vaga_id = COALESCE(NEW.vaga_id, OLD.vaga_id) AND status = 'em_andamento' ), contratados = ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.processos_seletivos WHERE vaga_id = COALESCE(NEW.vaga_id, OLD.vaga_id) AND status = 'contratado' ), updated_at = now() WHERE id = COALESCE(NEW.vaga_id, OLD.vaga_id); RETURN COALESCE(NEW, OLD); END;

log_etapa_change.body: BEGIN IF OLD.etapa_atual IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.etapa_atual THEN INSERT INTO public.historico_etapas (processo_id, etapa_anterior, etapa_nova) VALUES (NEW.id, OLD.etapa_atual, NEW.etapa_atual); END IF; RETURN NEW; END;

handle_new_candidate_user.body: BEGIN IF NEW.raw_user_meta_data ->> 'user_type' = 'candidato' THEN INSERT INTO public.candidatos_auth (user_id, nome, email, telefone) VALUES ( NEW.id, COALESCE(NEW.raw_user_meta_data ->> 'nome', NEW.email), NEW.email, NEW.raw_user_meta_data ->> 'telefone' ); END IF; RETURN NEW; END;

update_avaliacoes_updated_at.body: BEGIN NEW.updated_at = NOW(); RETURN NEW; END;

update_user_2fa_updated_at.body: BEGIN NEW.updated_at = NOW(); RETURN NEW; END;

update_candidatos_search_vector.body: BEGIN NEW.search_vector := setweight(to_tsvector('portuguese_unaccent', coalesce(NEW.nome, '')), 'A') || setweight(to_tsvector('portuguese_unaccent', coalesce(NEW.email, '')), 'B') || setweight(to_tsvector('portuguese_unaccent', coalesce(NEW.cargo_atual, '')), 'B') || setweight(to_tsvector('portuguese_unaccent', coalesce(array_to_string(NEW.skills, ' '), '')), 'C') || setweight(to_tsvector('portuguese_unaccent', coalesce(NEW.resumo, '')), 'D'); RETURN NEW; END;

update_vagas_search_vector.body: BEGIN NEW.search_vector := setweight(to_tsvector('portuguese_unaccent', coalesce(NEW.titulo, '')), 'A') || setweight(to_tsvector('portuguese_unaccent', coalesce(NEW.empresa, '')), 'B') || setweight(to_tsvector('portuguese_unaccent', coalesce(NEW.descricao, '')), 'C') || setweight(to_tsvector('portuguese_unaccent', coalesce(array_to_string(NEW.requisitos, ' '), '')), 'C'); RETURN NEW; END;

search_candidatos.body: DECLARE v_ingles_min integer; v_termo text; v_skill_qtd integer := COALESCE(array_length(p_skill_ids, 1), 0); v_limit integer := GREATEST(1, LEAST(COALESCE(p_limit, 30), 200)); v_offset integer := GREATEST(0, COALESCE(p_offset, 0)); v_order text := lower(COALESCE(p_order_by, 'created_at')); BEGIN v_termo := NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(p_termo, '')), ''); v_ingles_min := CASE lower(COALESCE(p_nivel_ingles_min, '')) WHEN 'nenhum' THEN 0 WHEN 'basico' THEN 1 WHEN 'intermediario' THEN 2 WHEN 'avancado' THEN 3 WHEN 'fluente' THEN 4 WHEN 'nativo' THEN 5 ELSE NULL END; IF v_order NOT IN ('created_at', 'nome', 'pretensao_asc', 'pretensao_desc', 'skills_match') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'ordenacao_invalida: %', …

search_vagas.returns:
TABLE (
    id UUID,
    titulo TEXT,
    departamento TEXT,
    rank REAL
)
search_vagas.body: BEGIN RETURN QUERY SELECT v.id, v.titulo, v.departamento, ts_rank(v.search_vector, plainto_tsquery('portuguese', search_query)) AS rank FROM public.vagas v WHERE v.search_vector @@ plainto_tsquery('portuguese', search_query) OR v.titulo ILIKE '%' || search_query || '%' ORDER BY rank DESC LIMIT limit_count; END;

create_default_tenant.body: BEGIN INSERT INTO public.tenants (name, slug) VALUES (NEW.email, REPLACE(SPLIT_PART(NEW.email, '@', 1), '.', '-') || '-' || SUBSTR(NEW.id::text, 1, 8)); INSERT INTO public.tenant_members (tenant_id, user_id, role) VALUES ((SELECT id FROM public.tenants ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1), NEW.id, 'owner'); RETURN NEW; END;

check_user_permission.args: user_uuid UUID, resource_name TEXT, action_name TEXT
check_user_permission.body: BEGIN RETURN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM public.user_roles ur JOIN public.role_permissions rp ON ur.role_id = rp.role_id JOIN public.permissions p ON rp.permission_id = p.id WHERE ur.user_id = user_uuid AND p.resource = resource_name AND p.action = action_name ); END;

audit_trigger_func.body: BEGIN IF TG_OP = 'INSERT' THEN PERFORM log_audit_event('create', TG_TABLE_NAME, NEW.id::TEXT, NULL, to_jsonb(NEW)); RETURN NEW; ELSIF TG_OP = 'UPDATE' THEN PERFORM log_audit_event('update', TG_TABLE_NAME, NEW.id::TEXT, to_jsonb(OLD), to_jsonb(NEW)); RETURN NEW; ELSIF TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN PERFORM log_audit_event('delete', TG_TABLE_NAME, OLD.id::TEXT, to_jsonb(OLD), NULL); RETURN OLD; END IF; RETURN NULL; END;

log_audit_event.args: p_action TEXT, p_resource_type TEXT, p_resource_id TEXT DEFAULT NULL, p_old_data JSONB DEFAULT NULL, p_new_data JSONB DEFAULT NULL, p_metadata JSONB DEFAULT '{}'
log_audit_event.body: DECLARE v_log_id UUID; BEGIN INSERT INTO public.audit_logs (user_id, action, resource_type, resource_id, old_data, new_data, metadata) VALUES (auth.uid(), p_action, p_resource_type, p_resource_id, p_old_data, p_new_data, p_metadata) RETURNING id INTO v_log_id; RETURN v_log_id; END;

cleanup_old_logs.body: BEGIN DELETE FROM public.rate_limit_logs WHERE created_at < now() - interval '30 days'; DELETE FROM public.ip_access_logs WHERE created_at < now() - interval '90 days'; DELETE FROM public.user_2fa_logs WHERE created_at < now() - interval '90 days'; DELETE FROM public.blocked_ips WHERE expires_at < now() AND is_permanent = false; DELETE FROM public.password_reset_tokens WHERE expires_at < now(); DELETE FROM public.trusted_devices WHERE expires_at < now(); END;

has_permission.body: SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM public.user_roles ur JOIN public.role_permissions rp ON rp.role = ur.role JOIN public.permissions p ON p.id = rp.permission_id WHERE ur.user_id = _user_id AND p.module = _module AND p.action = _action )

cleanup_old_login_attempts.body: BEGIN DELETE FROM public.login_attempts WHERE last_attempt_at < now() - interval '24 hours' AND (locked_until IS NULL OR locked_until < now()); END;

calculate_level_from_xp.body: BEGIN IF xp_amount >= 5500 THEN RETURN 10; ELSIF xp_amount >= 4000 THEN RETURN 9; ELSIF xp_amount >= 3000 THEN RETURN 8; ELSIF xp_amount >= 2200 THEN RETURN 7; ELSIF xp_amount >= 1500 THEN RETURN 6; ELSIF xp_amount >= 1000 THEN RETURN 5; ELSIF xp_amount >= 600 THEN RETURN 4; ELSIF xp_amount >= 300 THEN RETURN 3; ELSIF xp_amount >= 100 THEN RETURN 2; ELSE RETURN 1; END IF; END;

add_user_xp.body: DECLARE v_current_xp INTEGER; v_current_level INTEGER; v_final_amount INTEGER; v_new_xp INTEGER; v_new_level INTEGER; BEGIN v_final_amount := ROUND(p_amount * p_multiplier); INSERT INTO user_gamification (user_id, xp, level) VALUES (p_user_id, 0, 1) ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO NOTHING; SELECT xp, level INTO v_current_xp, v_current_level FROM user_gamification WHERE user_id = p_user_id; v_new_xp := v_current_xp + v_final_amount; v_new_level := calculate_level_from_xp(v_new_xp); UPDATE user_gamification SET xp = v_new_xp, level = v_new_level, total_actions = total_actions + 1, updated_at = now() WHERE user_id = p_user_id; INSERT INTO xp_transactions (user_id, amount, action, description, multipli …

update_user_streak.body: DECLARE v_last_active DATE; v_today DATE := CURRENT_DATE; v_current_streak INTEGER; v_longest_streak INTEGER; v_new_streak INTEGER; v_bonus INTEGER := 0; BEGIN INSERT INTO user_gamification (user_id, xp, level) VALUES (p_user_id, 0, 1) ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO NOTHING; SELECT last_active_date, streak, longest_streak INTO v_last_active, v_current_streak, v_longest_streak FROM user_gamification WHERE user_id = p_user_id; IF v_last_active = v_today THEN new_streak := v_current_streak; streak_bonus := 0; RETURN NEXT; RETURN; ELSIF v_last_active = v_today - 1 THEN v_new_streak := v_current_streak + 1; ELSE v_new_streak := 1; END IF; IF v_new_streak = 7 THEN v_bonus := 100; ELSIF v_new_streak = 30 …

safe_update_gamification.args: p_streak integer DEFAULT NULL, p_last_active_date date DEFAULT NULL
safe_update_gamification.body: BEGIN UPDATE user_gamification SET streak = COALESCE(p_streak, streak), last_active_date = COALESCE(p_last_active_date, last_active_date), total_actions = total_actions + 1, updated_at = now() WHERE user_id = auth.uid(); END;

award_xp.args: p_action text, p_amount integer, p_description text DEFAULT NULL
award_xp.body: BEGIN IF p_amount > 100 OR p_amount < 0 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid XP amount'; END IF; INSERT INTO xp_transactions (user_id, action, amount, description) VALUES (auth.uid(), p_action, p_amount, p_description); UPDATE user_gamification SET xp = xp + p_amount, updated_at = now() WHERE user_id = auth.uid(); END;

check_rate_limit.body: DECLARE v_window timestamptz := date_trunc('second', now()) - make_interval(secs => (extract(epoch from now())::int % p_window_seconds)); v_count integer; BEGIN INSERT INTO public.rate_limits (route, key, window_start, count) VALUES (p_route, p_key, v_window, 1) ON CONFLICT (route, key, window_start) DO UPDATE SET count = public.rate_limits.count + 1, updated_at = now() RETURNING count INTO v_count; DELETE FROM public.rate_limits WHERE window_start < now() - interval '24 hours'; RETURN v_count <= p_max; END;

# 🎯 Match ATS

**Sistema de Gestão de Candidatos (ATS) completo e moderno**

[![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-5.0-blue)](https://www.typescriptlang.org/)
[![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-18.3-61DAFB)](https://reactjs.org/)
[![Vite](https://img.shields.io/badge/Vite-5.4-646CFF)](https://vitejs.dev/)
[![TailwindCSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind-3.4-38B2AC)](https://tailwindcss.com/)

## ✨ Funcionalidades

### Core
- 📝 Gestão de vagas e candidatos
- 🔄 Pipeline visual de recrutamento (Kanban)
- 📊 Dashboard de analytics
- 🔍 Busca e filtros avançados

### Autenticação & Segurança
- 🔐 Autenticação com 2FA (TOTP)
- 🔑 SSO (SAML 2.0 / OIDC)
- 🛡️ Conformidade LGPD

### Integrações
- **Job Boards**: LinkedIn, Indeed, Catho, Vagas.com.br, InfoJobs
- **Calendários**: Google Calendar, Outlook Calendar
- **Comunicação**: Slack, Microsoft Teams
- **IA**: Parser de currículos, Match Score

### Automação
- ⚙️ Editor de workflows visual (React Flow)
- 🔔 Notificações automáticas
- 📅 Agendamento de entrevistas

## 🚀 Instalação

```bash
git clone https://github.com/adm01-debug/match.git
cd match
npm install
npm run dev
```

### Dependências Adicionais

```bash
npm install reactflow qrcode.react xlsx @react-pdf/renderer workbox-window
npm install -D @chromatic-com/storybook
```

## 📁 Estrutura

```
src/
├── components/
│   ├── admin/        # Configurações
│   ├── analytics/    # Dashboards
│   ├── auth/         # Autenticação
│   ├── common/       # Compartilhados
│   ├── ia/           # IA features
│   ├── integrations/ # Conectores
│   ├── reports/      # Relatórios
│   └── workflow/     # Automações
├── hooks/            # Custom hooks
├── services/         # APIs
└── pages/            # Páginas
```

## 📚 Documentação

### 🔎 Acesso rápido
- 🏁 [Benchmark GeekHunter — análise em 20 etapas](docs/BENCHMARK_GEEKHUNTER.md)
- 🗺️ [Plano de Melhorias — 50 etapas](docs/PLANO_MELHORIAS_50_ETAPAS.md)

### Demais documentos
- [Auditoria Enterprise 10/10 (Markdown)](audit_report.md)
- [Auditoria Enterprise 10/10 (PDF)](audit_report.pdf)
- [API Reference](docs/API_REFERENCE.md)
- [Webhooks](docs/WEBHOOKS.md)
- [SDK](docs/SDK.md)

## 🛠️ Stack

React 18 • TypeScript • Vite • Tailwind • shadcn/ui • TanStack Query • Supabase
